verdict.rationale: Customer.io ships an official CLI that gives "AI agents and scripts full access" to workspaces. It exposes the Journeys and Pipelines APIs through a single `cio api` command, returns structured JSON from every command, and makes endpoints self-describing via `cio schema`, which suits headless automation. Key-authenticated Track/App/Pipelines APIs with a published OpenAPI spec back this up. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation (e.g., pipeline examples or GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive or token-based CLI auth for unattended runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.
